title: Business App registry record and per-repo classification
x-normativity: Shape normative here. Per-class flow treatment (which extraction runs for which class) is the prose table in workflow-spec §8. A declaration always wins over detection.

repo.description: org/repo or org/repo//subtree for monorepos — subtrees classify independently (ADR-029)

method.description: declared = kind: in throughline.yaml (always wins) · detected = archetype detection · steward = manual reclassification from the UI

detectionEvidence.description: For method=detected: which archetype rules fired (rules are code-reviewed, versioned configuration)

confidence.description: Low-confidence detection yields class=unknown (scan-light + steward confirmation), never a silent guess

repos.description: Catalog membership — the catalog remains the membership authority (ADR-025)

memberRepos.description: Resolved membership with activity and classification: catalog repos annotated with active-set membership (test-automation authority, ADR-025) and ADR-029 class

active.description: In the test-automation active set; false ⇒ coverage state dormant — visible, never silently skipped

criticalityTier.description: Wave-planner ordering input (08 §2): Tier-1 apps baseline first
